Name: Cloudberries As Forage
Author: KronosTitanAnthem
Description:
[b]This mod is for 1.6 only!

[/b]Credit to x7eventy7 for the new item and crop sprites!

This mod adds a new forage item, the cloudberry (it's a real thing by the way; it's a rare fruit found in arctic areas; for more information check this wikipedia article: [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rubus_chamaemorus]https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rubus_chamaemorus﻿[/url]﻿﻿).

Content:
[list]
[*]You can find Cloudberries in the Secret Woods in winter.
[*]Cloudberries give 150 energy, 67 health, and a +2 foraging level boost. They sell for 320g.
[*]Cloudberries are classified as a fruit, so you can make Cloudberry Jelly, Cloudberry Wine, and Dried Cloudberry.
[*]Putting them in the seed maker will give you Cloudberry Seeds that take 10 days to grow.
[*]If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21514]Forage Crops[/url][color=#f4f4f4], Cloudberry crops will turn into forageable cloudberries when fully grown, much like the vanilla Wild Seeds. If you don't, it will just grow them like a regular crop instead.[/color]
[/list]
